title: Vertiv buys switchgear maker E&I Engineering for $1.8B

sources.quote: it has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire E&I Engineering Ireland Limited and its affiliate, Powerbar Gulf LLC
for approximately $1.8 billion in upfront consideration plus the potential for up to $200 million in cash, based on achieving certain 2022 profit milestones.

explain: Vertiv paid about $1.8 billion in cash and stock (plus up to $200 million more tied to 2022 profits) for E&I Engineering, an Irish maker of switchgear and busway that distributes electricity inside data centers. The deal closed in November 2021.
